summary: A crowded meeting does not end in a vote, but the board puts the item on the next agenda.
realLife: At Weddington, a hearing with about 500 people ended with the public hearing continued to a later meeting rather than a vote.
sources: WSOC-TV, hundreds at Weddington town hearing: https://www.wsoctv.com/news/local/development-debate-brings-hundreds-raucous-weddington-town-meeting/BATFRWXP6NCZFBC2CEMHZBD7IY
inGame: a posted meeting of the town's body and agenda records; no school or school board needed

turns.summary: The board votes at the next meeting.
The sponsor withdraws and the item never returns.
The board returns with an amended plan.
